question: A train 200 m long running at 54 km/h crosses a 100 m long platform. How long does it take?
question_ne: २०० मिटर लामो रेल ५४ किमी/घण्टाको गतिमा १०० मिटर लामो प्लेटफर्म पार गर्छ। कति समय लाग्छ?
explanation: Distance = 200 + 100 = 300 m. Speed = 15 m/s. Time = 300/15 = 20 seconds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
